title: October at The Anchor
preheader: Dark evenings, three brilliant nights out, and Halloween done properly.

data.alt: The Anchor, Stanwell Moor Village, since 1751. Autumn leaves and berries around the wordmark.

data.heading: October's here, and we're leaning right into it
body: There's something about the first properly dark evening of the year. The lights go on, the fire gets going, and suddenly a Wednesday feels like an occasion. October's our favourite month for exactly that reason, and we've gone all in on it.

Three nights out, each with its own bit of mischief, building to Halloween itself on the Saturday. Whether that's a quiz, a horror singalong or full fancy dress, there's one here with your name on it.

events.name: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night
events.detail: Teams of up to six, £3 cash on the night. A few spooky touches, no horror expertise required.

image.alt: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

events.name: Screams & Soundtracks Music Bingo
events.detail: Two rounds of classic horror soundtracks with Nikki in charge. £5 cash, and dressing up is encouraged.

image.alt: Screams and Soundtracks classic horror music bingo at The Anchor

events.name: House of Horrors Halloween Party
events.detail: Free entry, fancy dress and the bar open until midnight. Come early if you want a good spot.

image.alt: Enter If You Dare, the House of Horrors Halloween party at The Anchor

data.heading: When we're open
data.footnote: Last orders are 30 minutes before the kitchen closes and 15 minutes before the bar does. The clocks go back on Sunday 25 October, but our hours don't change.

data.heading: One date is different

rows.note: Full menu 12pm to 6pm, kitchen shut 6pm to 9pm, then pizza only

data.footnote: Halloween is the only date in October that differs from the week above. Pizza from 9pm is available to eat in or to take away.

image.alt: A Sunday roast at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

cards.heading: Sunday roast
cards.body: Carved fresh every Sunday, 1pm to 6pm. Nothing to order ahead, so you can decide on the day.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner laid out at The Anchor

cards.heading: Christmas is booking
cards.body: The good dates go first. If you've a work do or a family table in mind, now's the moment.

data.heading: And when November comes
body: Sparks & Sparklers Quiz Night on Wednesday 4 November. Then Sequins & Showstoppers Music Bingo on Friday the 13th, and the Snowball Showdown on Wednesday the 18th. We'll nudge you nearer the time.

data.body: Quiz team, fancy dress, or just a quiet pint by the fire. Whatever brings you in this month, we'd love to see you.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, because you said we could get in touch, or because you are just down the road and we thought this would be useful. It may have been a while ago now, and it is good to still be in touch.
